patterns.note: Content sections frequently use a multi-column grid for displaying destinations, cabin features, or informational links, maintaining consistent spacing.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold headings for key messages and smaller, highly legible text for body content and functional labels.
A vibrant red is used exclusively for primary calls-to-action, interactive elements, and brand accents, providing clear visual hierarchy and brand recognition.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page shrinks in height and gains a solid white background as the user scrolls down, becoming a sticky header.
Large, full-width hero and promotional sections feature immersive background photography with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability.

technique_notes: Sticky header transformation: The initial transparent header with a subtle top bar transitions into a compact, solid white sticky navigation bar with a reduced height upon scrolling past the hero section.

Immersive background sections: Full-width sections utilize high-quality photography as a background, often with a semi-transparent dark overlay to enhance the contrast and readability of overlaid text and calls-to-action.

Grid-based content presentation: Information such as featured destinations, cabin features, and service categories are presented in uniform card-like modules arranged in responsive grids, ensuring visual consistency and easy scanning.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (e.g., ~3x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by clear, legible body text and smaller, functional labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., ~4-8px) are applied to buttons, input fields, and some card elements, contributing to a polished but not overly soft feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy hero and promotional sections, and tighter, more information-dense grids for features and the footer.

standout: The site stands out with its seamless integration of a highly functional flight search experience directly within an immersive, brand-rich hero section. The transforming sticky navigation provides a polished user experience, maintaining brand presence without being intrusive.
